recent_items.summary: Multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse task requirements. We introduce DynaFlow, a framework that integrates free-form executable workflow synthesis into the action space of the main agent. recent_items.title: DynaFlow: Learning Free-Form Multi-Agent Orchestration
